author: Jennifer Scott
text:
I cannot say enough good things about Chandler, Richard, and Dusty! They truly went above and beyond for my clients and made sure everyone involved was taken care of — both the seller and the buyer.

They didn’t leave until the job was completely finished and everything was made right. But what impressed me just as much as their work was the reassurance they gave everyone throughout the entire process. They took the time to explain what was happening, talked us through everything, and made what could have been a very stressful situation feel completely manageable.

I honestly can’t express how grateful I am for not only the work they did, but for the way they treated everyone involved. That means a lot to me as an agent when I’m trusting someone to take care of my clients.

Chandler, Richard, and Dusty are absolutely TOP NOTCH, and I would recommend them to EVERYONE! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Deborah James
text: Super thankful for Dusty he came out after supper hour and got my septic cleared out! I’m new at owning a septic and had no idea that it needed to be pumped every 3-4 years, I’d spent a fortune buying green gobbler and Dusty told me that I was wasting my money 🤦‍♀️. He also told us never to put wipes and grease into the septic tank. Big thanks for going above and beyond!

author: D Day
text: I needed the septic tank pumped and had no idea where it was! They got to me asap and took care of what I needed for a reasonable price. Good dudes.

author: Jessica McClamroch
text: Great experience with American Septic Pumping! They came super fast and cleaned out our septic tank! Usually you wait for weeks for anyone to even show up but not these guys! I was impressed how quick they did the work as well! Everything was done very professional! 👍🏻
